name: com.getmcpads/bing-ads
title: Microsoft Advertising (Bing Ads)
description: Microsoft Advertising (Bing Ads) MCP server: 20 read tools, 23 opt-in preview-first writes.

environmentVariables.name: BING_ADS_DEVELOPER_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Your developer token. Required in production; the sandbox uses the universal token.

environmentVariables.name: BING_ADS_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Application (client) ID of your OAuth app registration.

environmentVariables.name: BING_ADS_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Client secret, only for a web app registration or Google identity.

environmentVariables.name: BING_ADS_REFRESH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Refresh token with the msads.manage and offline_access scopes. Kept in memory only.

environmentVariables.name: BING_ADS_CUSTOMER_ID
environmentVariables.description: Customer ID that owns the accounts, unless every account entry carries its own.

environmentVariables.name: BING_ADS_ACCOUNT_IDS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated allowed account IDs, optionally accountId:customerId. Required even for reads.

environmentVariables.name: BING_ADS_IDENTITY_PROVIDER
environmentVariables.description: Microsoft (default) or Google, for users who sign in with Google.

environmentVariables.name: BING_ADS_OAUTH_TENANT
environmentVariables.description: Microsoft Entra tenant for the token endpoint. Defaults to common.

environmentVariables.name: BING_ADS_ENABLE_WRITES
environmentVariables.description: true exposes 23 write tools. Defaults to false. Writes preview until confirm:true.
